read.title: Great Meeting You Today
read.text:
Dear Mr. Grant,

Thank you for taking the time to meet with our team today. It was a pleasure to finally meet you in person after so many emails.

We were impressed by your expertise in the European retail market, and we believe there is a strong mutual interest in growing our brand there together. As discussed, we will send you samples of our three best-selling serums by the end of next week, along with a detailed price list.

Please also let us know a convenient date for a follow-up call with your purchasing manager. We would like to answer any questions before you make a decision.

We look forward to working with you and building a long-term partnership.

Best regards,
Minsu

Dear Ms. Clark,

Thank you for taking the time to meet with us today. It was a pleasure to finally meet you in person. As promised, I will send you our product catalog and a sample kit by Friday. We look forward to working with you.

Best regards,
Minsu
